blocked_v6_launches.history: The first v6 launch failed at import because admission_roots.py had not been copied beside the derived driver, before creating anything under its data root. The relaunch on that root stopped as blocked because the pre-launch data-placement record was absent. The one-shot root is retained; the driver was re-derived for the fresh root above, whose placement record was written before launch.

fixture: Nickel recursive producer fields now refer to a distinct lexical plan_producer binding; unchanged product, signed inputs, pin cohort, runtime and identity predicates.
The consumer root is labelled by its Nickel field (app); it is selected by its derivation name with the same exactly-one and marker-byte checks.
